file.content: Todos

lines: +  <input class="search" data-testid="search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search todos" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search todos">
-  // [REQ-002] [REQ-005] Active todos first, then completed; by priority, then insertion order within each group.
+  // [REQ-007] Case-insensitive substring match; an empty term matches everything.
+  // [REQ-007] Replace a todo's text. Blank text keeps the old text.
+  // [REQ-002] [REQ-005] [REQ-007] Search narrows the list; then active first, completed below, by priority and insertion order.
+  // [REQ-007] Double-click turns the text into a field. Enter or blur commits; Escape cancels.

content.text: I added inline editing: double-click the text to edit it, Enter or blur saves, Escape cancels. Clearing the text keeps the old text, and I didn't make it delete the todo. Search (`search-input`) matches any part of the text, ignores case, doesn't trim spaces, and works with the active filter.
